operations.legality: Same Z sign-vector route, inclusive. Usable first point: rail or z<=ground. Reject invalid pattern, car, protected/nonreclaimable obstruction, ground<=z<=water when ground<water. Existing middle rail cannot take two edges.
operations.mutation: Reclaim eligible whole entities, create rail or attach one endpoint edge; best-effort piers only on newly created rail. No preview side effects.
operations.booking: RAIL_SERVICE sum(6000000*M(z-ground)+entityValue per quoted reclaimable cell), including existing endpoint attachment; M(h)=-2h if negative else h+1.
operations.removal: Inclusive normal removal; count any unoccupied rail even no-op subtype/edge. Spend count*2000000*(abs(endZ-water)+1); then subtype detach and source support teardown for every visited cell regardless of pier owner (owner-confirmed D006).

operations.legality: Existing edge succeeds. Well-connected requires two reciprocal same-Z neighbors. Normal pair: new-edge angle1/3/4 to both if well-connected; otherwise >=3 to at least one. Other subtypes only existing edges.
operations.mutation: Well-connected normal becomes matching junction; open pair retains first qualifying dir1 else dir2. Direction scans low/high index.
operations.booking: No standalone spend; normal-route callers charge inclusive attachment/removal even if unchanged.
operations.removal: Single clears on either matched edge. Junction two matches clears, one converts to remaining normal pair, zero no-op. Slope/special detach no-op.

operations.legality: Cardinal, baseZ+1 within ceiling; four XY positions with both Z levels empty, including no Traffic. Removal checks four car locations and owning ramp validity, second rail zdiff=1/zangle.
operations.mutation: Four rails at base+i*d+(0,0,i//2), fillers above i0/1 and walls/supports below i2/3. Per-column baseZ<ground chooses underground art; stored ground flags. Elect directional-style piers.
operations.booking: RAIL_SERVICE build 40000000*M(baseZ-water); remove 8000000*(abs(baseZ+1-water)+1). No generic entity-removal charge.
operations.removal: Slope tool resolves member to base, clears four rails/paired cells and piers under base. SlopeEntity.remove excludes piers from its direct cube scan, but its TrafficVoxel.remove callbacks tear down piers below each rail and remove whole Traffic voxels, with no tool booking. P4-10 corrects the earlier direct-scan-only reading; D006 remains owner-agnostic at every call site.

operations.legality: Election scans z0..railZ-1; any occupied voxel prevents piers but does not reject track.
operations.mutation: Create ground..railZ-1 with selected top/body style and owner; ordinary/girder default, slope N/E default S/W slope.
operations.booking: No separate spend; rail operation charge applies.
operations.removal: Delete every BridgePierVoxel in the same XY column z0..railZ-1 regardless of owner, as confirmed by the owner in D006. Preview every affected pier/owner; preserve non-pier occupants and owning rails/entities. No owner-only restriction or new full-ramp cleanup.

operations.legality: Different points, cardinal straight fixed-Z selection; empty or Traffic with both axis edges. No actual water requirement. Car replacement protection is service fence.
operations.mutation: Leave compatible rails; create Begin then Middle/End for new runs. Single new cell Begin. Alternating new-cell piers; existing rail resets run but not pier toggle.
operations.booking: RAIL_SERVICE all inclusive cells build6000000*M(z-ground), remove2000000*M(z-ground), even unchanged/wrong subtype/train skips. Both quotes early-return0 on starting-cell underwater condition.
operations.removal: Inclusive, matching BridgeRail/axis only; TrainCar skips, charge still includes it; clear rail and source support teardown (D006).

operations.legality: Eight-way straight fixed-Z, each cell above local ground; empty or Traffic with both axis edges.
operations.mutation: New cells RailImpl/default piers; existing compatible rails stay. Sprite axis0/1/2/3 ->3/1/0/2; before pass only.
operations.booking: Same all-inclusive ground-relative6000000/2000000 formulas and first-cell water early-zero as bridge.
operations.removal: Inclusive matching RailImpl/axis; TrainCar skips but is charged; source pier teardown (D006).

operations.legality: Different points cardinal straight fixed-Z, z>=water, at least one actual Mountain. Other occupied cells must be Traffic with compatible axis rail.
operations.mutation: Save four Mountain offsets, replace with TunnelRail; other empty route cells become SingleRailRoad; existing rails stay. Ground unchanged; trees/ownership/overlay lost.
operations.booking: RAIL_SERVICE12000000 per newly created cell inclusive; removal4000000 per matching tunnel actually restored, excluding endpoint and TrainCar skips.
operations.removal: [from,to), matching tunnel/axis only, skip TrainCar; restore unowned undecorated Mountain from saved offsets. Ordinary gap rails and final destination stay (GEO-006).

operations.legality: Different points cardinal straight fixed-Z, actual ground equality every cell; empty or compatible Traffic rail. Reject car replacement at service boundary.
operations.mutation: Replace every inclusive cell with GarageRail, preserving Traffic components, axis front/back sprites; no maintenance mechanic.
operations.booking: RAIL_SERVICE6500000 per inclusive build cell. Half-open removal: matching axis garage increments subtotal200000 even when car blocks conversion; spend current subtotal on EVERY visited iteration.
operations.removal: [from,to), convert matching garage to normal rail unless any car. Endpoint stays. Three selected cells/two matching visits spend200000+400000=600000, source retained.

operations.legality: Four directions and exact bundled type. Empty/Traffic no rail or SingleRailRoad accepted, other subtypes/nonTraffic rejected. Add planned car fence.
operations.mutation: Replace rail with chosen straight signal/type/direction. needsToDrawAfter true draws signal in before pass; false in after. P5 gets harbor/controller boundary.
operations.booking: No source spend on placement/removal; not contribution-price-derived.
operations.removal: Any car rejects removal; restore SingleRailRoad with signal pattern. No passenger exchange implied.

operations.legality: Traffic rail with exactly two opposite cardinal edges, subtype-independent. Existing accessory/car not excluded by source.
operations.mutation: Infer N/S versus E/W from rail pattern; replace one accessory slot, no simulated electrification; non-null replacement does not invoke old onRemoved.
operations.booking: No build/remove spend caller, despite price-capable base and native cost control.
operations.removal: Remove any ElectricPole regardless selected type by accessory=null; callback invoked, rail/road/car preserved.

operations.legality: Full exclusive footprint and height, equal ground across base, reclaimable player occupants. Invisible upper voxels occupy. Active menu uses FixedSizeStructController, not inverted separate builder.
operations.mutation: Create pending ConstructionSite then completed owned/nonreclaimable/value0 RailStationaryStructure. Preserve site progress/completion/cancel boundary with P7 shared consumer.
operations.booking: Completion constructor spends type.price to RAIL_SERVICE; completed removal spends500000*sizeX*sizeY to SUBSIDIARIES. Site cancellation does not invoke completion price.
operations.removal: Select actual structure independent of current catalog type, remove full footprint. Protect canonical dependencies. Pending-site cancellation clears callback/state; no instant completion adaptation authorized.

operations.legality: Inclusive same-Z sign-vector/RailPattern route; TrafficVoxel at every selected location, not necessarily rail. Reject any overlap across all three lists. Coincident selection empty.
operations.mutation: Add selected Low/Medium/Fast membership using Hashtable keys, dedup within chosen list. No world geometry/clock change.
operations.removal: Remove one occurrence per selected key from all three lists. Cleanup only locations with no TrafficVoxel, not every rail-less location.

operations.legality: Cardinal four locations base+i*d+(0,0,i//2), each Traffic, no overlap. Source guard does not require SlopeRailRoad at placement.
operations.mutation: Append four entries to selected list (ArrayList path). Persist per-world list state initialized without opening menu. P5 gets prior-head-location numeric equality timing.
operations.removal: Resolve clicked slope member/base and validate owning direction before selection; remove one occurrence in all lists; absent-Traffic cleanup as flat path.

operations.legality: Source allows rail+road coexistence. Crossing requires exactly two opposite cardinal rail edges plus perpendicular road edges, and empty accessory slot for creation.
operations.mutation: Auto-create RRCrossing if conditions/empty slot; remove only crossing when conditions lost. Existing pole suppresses crossing; no added general road-conflict rule.
operations.booking: No separate source crossing charge; rail/road owning operation booking applies.
operations.removal: Remove crossing as conditions disappear; preserve unrelated road/car/accessory components. Road/train/platform fixtures are trusted P4 interface evidence, not later gameplay delivery.
